purpose: Transparent native UI control-state export for the art-only phase
notes: locked is an exact copy of existing disabled art with a baked lock; semantic reuse is declared.
pressed/disabled are native DOM/CSS state composites, not AI generation or new painting.
All rendered images use the native source canvas, deviceScaleFactor 1, no transform and no resampling size change.
No dynamic text or base64 media payload is stored in this record.
